title: Get that cash feat. Big E the prof
description: “Get That Cash” is a high-energy, late-night anthem built for flashing lights and fast money. Miycho teams up with Big E the Prof to deliver a slick, confident track about hustle, temptation, and living in the moment. With hypnotic vibes and a club-ready bounce, it captures the grind and glamour of chasing cash while the night unfolds.
